name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
department: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education
applyChannel: the National Scholarship Portal after clearing the state NMMS exam
description: Scholarship to reduce dropouts at Class 8 by supporting meritorious students from economically weaker sections through Class 9 to 12.
whoCanApply: Students in government / aided / local body schools who clear the state-level NMMS selection test, with parental income up to ₹3.5 lakh.
benefits: ₹12,000 per year from Class 9 to Class 12.
deadlineInfo: State NMMS exam is held once a year; NSP applications follow.

rules.label: Cleared the state NMMS selection exam and studies in a government/aided school

documents.name: NMMS exam result
documents.why: Selection is based on the exam.

process: Appear for the NMMS exam conducted by your state.
Renew each year by meeting marks criteria.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for Minority Communities
department: Ministry of Minority Affairs
description: Scholarship for students from notified minority communities studying at Class 11 and above.
whoCanApply: Students from Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain and Parsi communities with at least 50% marks in the previous exam and family income up to ₹2 lakh.
benefits: Admission / tuition fee support and maintenance allowance as per scheme norms.

rules.label: Belongs to a notified minority community
Scored at least 50% in the previous final exam

name: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
department: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
description: Full financial support for SC students admitted to notified premier institutions such as IITs, IIMs, AIIMS and NITs.
whoCanApply: SC students admitted to a notified top-class institution with family income up to ₹8 lakh per year.
benefits: Full tuition and non-refundable fees, living expenses, books and a computer as per scheme norms.

rules.label: Admitted to an institution notified under the scheme

documents.name: Admission letter
documents.why: Shows admission to a notified institution.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Supports girl students admitted to the first year of an AICTE-approved degree or diploma course.
whoCanApply: Up to two girls per family, admitted to first year (or second year via lateral entry) of an AICTE-approved technical degree/diploma, with family income up to ₹8 lakh.
benefits: ₹50,000 per year for the course duration (as per current guidelines).

rules.label: In a technical degree or diploma course

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-Abled Students
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Supports specially-abled students pursuing AICTE-approved technical education.
whoCanApply: Students with disability of 40% or more admitted to an AICTE-approved degree/diploma, with family income up to ₹8 lakh.
benefits: ₹50,000 per year for the course duration (as per current guidelines).

rules.label: In a technical degree or diploma course

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
applyChannel: any bank branch or Business Correspondent (Bank Mitra)
description: Zero-balance basic savings bank account for every unbanked adult — the gateway to DBT, insurance and pension schemes.
whoCanApply: Any Indian citizen without a bank account (minors aged 10+ can open with a guardian).
benefits: Zero-balance account, RuPay debit card with accident insurance cover, and overdraft facility for eligible account holders.

rules.label: Does not yet have a savings bank account

documents.name: Aadhaar card or other officially valid document

process: Visit any bank branch or Bank Mitra.
Fill the account opening form with KYC.

name: e-Shram Card (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
department: Ministry of Labour & Employment
applyChannel: the e-Shram portal or a Common Service Centre
description: Registration for unorganised workers that links them to social security and welfare schemes.
whoCanApply: Unorganised workers aged 16–59 who are not EPFO/ESIC members and not income-tax payers.
benefits: Universal Account Number (UAN) card, access to social security schemes and accident insurance as notified.
estimatedBenefit: Worker ID + access to social security

rules.label: Not a member of EPFO or ESIC

process: Self-register on eshram.gov.in or visit a CSC.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
department: Ministry of Labour & Employment
applyChannel: a Common Service Centre or the Maandhan portal
description: Voluntary contributory pension scheme for unorganised workers, with matching government contribution.
whoCanApply: Unorganised workers aged 18–40 with monthly income up to ₹15,000, not EPFO/ESIC/NPS members and not income-tax payers.
benefits: Assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60.

documents.name: Savings bank account / Jan Dhan account

process: Visit a CSC with Aadhaar and bank details.

name: PM Vishwakarma
department: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
description: End-to-end support for traditional artisans and craftspeople in 18 trades such as carpentry, pottery, tailoring and smithing.
whoCanApply: Artisans aged 18+ working with hands and tools in one of the 18 listed family-based trades (one member per family).
benefits: Recognition certificate and ID, skill training with stipend, toolkit incentive, collateral-free credit at concessional interest and marketing support.
estimatedBenefit: Training, toolkit support and concessional credit
occupationRequirement: Traditional artisan in a listed trade

rules.label: Self-employed / works with hands and tools
Practises one of the 18 listed traditional trades (verified by Gram Panchayat / ULB)

process: Three-step verification by Gram Panchayat/ULB and district committee.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
applyChannel: banks, NBFCs, MFIs or the Udyamimitra portal
description: Collateral-free loans for non-farm micro and small enterprises in manufacturing, trading and services.
whoCanApply: Individuals and micro enterprises with a business plan for an income-generating non-farm activity.
benefits: Loans under Shishu, Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus categories (up to ₹20 lakh as per current limits) without collateral.

rules.label: Runs or plans a small non-farm business
Lender appraises your business plan and creditworthiness

process: Apply at a bank / NBFC / MFI or on Udyamimitra.

name: Stand-Up India
department: Department of Financial Services / SIDBI
applyChannel: the Stand-Up Mitra portal or any scheduled commercial bank branch
description: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs setting up a greenfield enterprise.
whoCanApply: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs aged 18+ setting up a new (greenfield) enterprise in manufacturing, services, trading or agri-allied activities.
benefits: Composite loan of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore with handholding support.

rules.label: Woman entrepreneur (or SC/ST — see indicator below)
Setting up a new greenfield enterprise; not a loan defaulter

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
department: KVIC, Ministry of MSME
description: Credit-linked subsidy for setting up new micro enterprises in rural and urban areas.
whoCanApply: Individuals aged 18+; Class 8 pass required for larger manufacturing/service projects. Only new projects qualify.
benefits: Margin-money subsidy of 15–35% of project cost depending on category and area.

rules.label: Some formal education (Class 8 pass needed for larger projects)
Proposing a new project; not already availing other government subsidy for it

process: Task force interview and bank appraisal.

name: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)
department: Ministry of Education
description: Paid one-year apprenticeships for fresh graduates and diploma holders in industry.
whoCanApply: Graduates and diploma holders in engineering, general streams or vocational courses, usually within a few years of passing.
benefits: Monthly stipend (partly reimbursed by government) and a Certificate of Proficiency.

rules.label: Holds (or is completing) a diploma or degree
Passed out within the period allowed by NATS

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / NABARD
applyChannel: any bank branch (form also available on the PM-KISAN portal)
description: Short-term credit for crop cultivation, post-harvest and allied activities at concessional interest.
whoCanApply: Farmers — owner cultivators, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, SHGs and joint liability groups; also animal husbandry and fisheries farmers.
benefits: Revolving crop loan with interest subvention; prompt repayment incentives reduce the effective rate.

rules.label: Is a farmer (owner, tenant or sharecropper)

process: Fill the KCC form at your bank.
Bank verifies land and crop details.

faqs.a: KCC is issued by banks. Official application link requires verification for your bank.

name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Pumps for Farmers)
department: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy
applyChannel: your state's implementing agency (links on the PM-KUSUM portal)
description: Subsidised standalone solar pumps and solarisation of grid-connected pumps for farmers.
whoCanApply: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, FPOs and cooperatives, as per state implementation.
benefits: Central and state subsidy covering a large share of solar pump cost.

rules.label: Has cultivable land for the pump
State agency has an open application window

process: Find your state agency on the portal.
Pay farmer share; pump is installed.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
department: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy
applyChannel: the PM Surya Ghar national portal
description: Subsidy for installing rooftop solar on homes, helping households get free electricity up to a monthly limit.
whoCanApply: Households that own a house with a suitable roof and a valid electricity connection, and have not availed another solar subsidy.
benefits: Central financial assistance for rooftop solar (higher per kW for smaller systems) and concessional loans.

rules.label: Owns a house with a roof suitable for solar
Has a valid electricity connection and no previous solar subsidy

process: Register on the portal with your DISCOM consumer number.
Choose a registered vendor and install.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
department: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
applyChannel: your ASHA worker, Anganwadi or government health facility
description: Cash assistance to promote institutional deliveries among poor pregnant women.
whoCanApply: Pregnant women — all women in low-performing states and BPL/SC/ST women in other states — delivering in a government or accredited facility.
benefits: Cash assistance on institutional delivery; amount differs between rural/urban and state categories.
process: Register pregnancy with ASHA / health centre.
Deliver at a government or accredited facility.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (NSAP)
department: Ministry of Rural Development (National Social Assistance Programme)
applyChannel: your Gram Panchayat / Taluk office or state social security portal
description: Monthly pension for widows from BPL households.
whoCanApply: Widows aged 40–79 belonging to BPL households.
benefits: Central assistance of ₹300 per month, with state top-ups.

rules.label: Is a widow (husband's death certificate required)

process: Apply at Gram Panchayat / Taluk office.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NSAP)
department: Ministry of Rural Development (National Social Assistance Programme)
description: One-time assistance to a BPL family on the death of its primary breadwinner.
whoCanApply: BPL households whose primary breadwinner (aged 18–59) has died.
benefits: Lump-sum assistance of ₹20,000.
deadlineInfo: Apply soon after the death; check state time limits.
process: Apply at the Gram Panchayat / Taluk office.

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
department: Ministry of Rural Development
applyChannel: your village's Self-Help Group or Block Mission office
description: Organises rural poor women into Self-Help Groups and supports them with credit, skills and livelihoods.
whoCanApply: Rural poor households, with at least one woman member joining a Self-Help Group.
benefits: Revolving fund, community investment fund, bank linkage at subsidised interest and livelihood training.

rules.label: Woman member to join a Self-Help Group

process: Contact your village SHG or Block Mission office.
Access revolving fund and bank credit.

name: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS)
department: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
applyChannel: a post office or authorised bank branch
description: Government-backed savings scheme giving senior citizens a regular quarterly interest income.
whoCanApply: Individuals aged 60+ (and certain retirees aged 55–60 under conditions).
benefits: Government-notified interest rate paid quarterly; deposits up to the notified limit; tax benefits.

rules.label: Has a bank / post office account

process: Visit a post office or authorised bank.
Fill the SCSS form and deposit.

name: Pudhumai Penn (Moovalur Ramamirtham Higher Education Assurance)
department: Social Welfare & Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
applyChannel: your college nodal officer / the Pudhumai Penn portal
description: Monthly assistance for girls who studied Class 6–12 in Tamil Nadu government schools and join higher education.
whoCanApply: Girl students who studied Class 6 to 12 in TN government schools and are pursuing higher education (degree, diploma, ITI).
benefits: ₹1,000 per month until course completion.
deadlineInfo: Enrol through your college each academic year.

rules.label: Studied Class 6–12 in a Tamil Nadu government school

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai (Tamil Nadu)
department: Government of Tamil Nadu
applyChannel: ration shop camps / the KMUT portal
description: Monthly entitlement for women heads of eligible Tamil Nadu families.
whoCanApply: Women heads of family aged 21+ in Tamil Nadu with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh and within land and electricity-use limits.
benefits: ₹1,000 per month credited to the woman head of family.

rules.label: No income-tax payer in the family

process: Apply at the notified camp or portal.

name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
department: Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
description: Cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals for low-income Tamil Nadu families, integrated with PM-JAY.
whoCanApply: Tamil Nadu families with annual income up to ₹1.2 lakh (and certain notified categories).
benefits: Cashless hospitalisation cover of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals.
process: Visit the district kiosk with documents.

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (Maharashtra)
department: Public Health Department, Government of Maharashtra
description: Cashless health insurance for Maharashtra families, integrated with PM-JAY.
whoCanApply: Maharashtra families holding a valid ration card or domicile proof as per current scheme expansion.
benefits: Cashless treatment for listed procedures at empanelled hospitals up to the notified family cover.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
department: Women & Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
applyChannel: the Ladki Bahin portal / Anganwadi / Setu centres
description: Monthly financial assistance for women in Maharashtra.
whoCanApply: Women aged 21–65 residing in Maharashtra (married, widowed, divorced, abandoned or one unmarried woman per family) with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.
benefits: ₹1,500 per month by DBT.
deadlineInfo: Check the portal for current registration status.

rules.label: Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh
rules.doc: Income certificate or yellow/orange ration card

rules.label: No income-tax payer in the family

documents.name: Income certificate or yellow/orange ration card

process: Apply on the portal or at an Anganwadi.

name: MahaDBT Scholarships (Maharashtra)
department: Government of Maharashtra (multiple departments)
description: Single portal for Maharashtra's post-matric scholarships, fee reimbursement and freeships across departments.
whoCanApply: Maharashtra domicile students in post-matric courses; category and income limits differ by scheme (up to ₹8 lakh for some).
benefits: Tuition/exam fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance, depending on scheme.

rules.label: Family income within the scheme limit (varies)

process: The portal shows schemes you qualify for.

name: UP Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement (Uttar Pradesh)
department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
description: Pre-matric and post-matric scholarships and fee reimbursement for UP students across categories.
whoCanApply: Uttar Pradesh students; income limits depend on category (commonly ₹2–2.5 lakh).
benefits: Scholarship and fee reimbursement as per category and course.
deadlineInfo: Annual timeline published on the portal.

rules.label: Studies in / domiciled in Uttar Pradesh
Family income within the category limit

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
department: Women Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
description: Staged financial support for girls from birth through graduation in Uttar Pradesh.
whoCanApply: UP resident families with annual income up to ₹3 lakh, for up to two daughters.
benefits: Instalments at birth, immunisation and school/college milestones (total as notified by the state).

rules.label: Has a daughter (milestones start at birth)

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa (West Bengal)
department: Department of Women & Child Development, Government of West Bengal
applyChannel: your school / college Kanyashree nodal officer
description: Conditional cash transfer to keep adolescent girls in education and delay marriage.
whoCanApply: Unmarried girls aged 13–19 studying in Class 8 or above in West Bengal, with family income up to ₹1.2 lakh (condition relaxed for some categories).
benefits: Annual scholarship (K1) and a one-time grant at 18 (K2) if still studying and unmarried.
deadlineInfo: Apply through your institution each year.

rules.label: Unmarried at the time of application

documents.name: Bank account in the girl's name

name: Swasthya Sathi (West Bengal)
department: Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal
description: Family health cover for West Bengal residents, with the card issued in the name of the senior woman of the family.
whoCanApply: West Bengal families not covered by other government health schemes.
benefits: Cashless secondary and tertiary care up to ₹5 lakh per family per year.

rules.label: Not covered by another government health insurance scheme

process: Apply at a Duare Sarkar camp.

name: Lakshmir Bhandar (West Bengal)
department: Department of Women & Child Development, Government of West Bengal
description: Monthly basic income support for women heads of West Bengal households.
whoCanApply: Women aged 25–60 residing in West Bengal with a Swasthya Sathi card, who are not permanent government employees or pensioners.
benefits: Monthly assistance by DBT, with a higher amount for SC/ST women (as notified).

rules.label: Not a permanent government employee or pensioner

process: Apply at a Duare Sarkar camp.

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
department: Women & Child Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
applyChannel: camps organised by Gram Panchayat / ward offices
description: Monthly financial assistance for women in Madhya Pradesh.
whoCanApply: Married women (including widowed, divorced, abandoned) aged 21–60, MP residents, with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh and no income-tax payer in the family.
benefits: Monthly DBT as notified by the state.

rules.label: No income-tax payer in the family

name: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi – KASP (Kerala)
department: State Health Agency, Government of Kerala
description: Kerala's health assurance scheme, integrated with PM-JAY, for eligible families.
whoCanApply: Families listed under PM-JAY / RSBY and those notified by the state (e.g., priority ration card holders).
benefits: Cashless treatment up to ₹5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals.

rules.label: Family listed in the KASP beneficiary database

process: Check eligibility at an empanelled hospital or Akshaya centre.

name: Rajiv Aarogyasri (Telangana)
department: Aarogyasri Health Care Trust, Government of Telangana
description: Cashless treatment for listed procedures for eligible Telangana families.
whoCanApply: Telangana families holding a white ration card / food security card.
benefits: Cashless treatment for listed therapies at network hospitals up to the notified family limit.

rules.label: Holds a white ration card / food security card

process: Visit a network hospital's Aarogyamithra desk.

name: Telangana ePASS Scholarships
department: Government of Telangana (Welfare Departments)
description: Post-matric scholarships and fee reimbursement for SC, ST, BC, EBC, minority and disabled students in Telangana.
whoCanApply: Telangana students in post-matric courses; income limits are typically ₹2 lakh (urban) / ₹1.5 lakh (rural) for BC/EBC/minority and higher for SC/ST.
benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance.

rules.label: Family income within the category limit

process: Apply and submit documents to your college.

name: Jnanabhumi Scholarships (Andhra Pradesh)
department: Government of Andhra Pradesh (Welfare Departments)
description: Andhra Pradesh's portal for post-matric scholarships and fee reimbursement.
whoCanApply: AP students in post-matric courses from eligible categories, with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.
benefits: Fee reimbursement and maintenance support as per current state schemes.

name: Digital Gujarat Scholarships
department: Government of Gujarat (Welfare Departments)
description: Gujarat's single portal for SC, ST, OBC and other category scholarships.
whoCanApply: Gujarat students from eligible categories; income limits vary by scheme (commonly ₹2.5 lakh).
benefits: Scholarship and fee support as per scheme.

rules.label: Family income within the scheme limit

name: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme
department: Education Department, Government of Bihar
applyChannel: the 7 Nishchay portal and your District Registration & Counselling Centre (DRCC)
description: Low-interest education loans for Bihar students who have passed Class 12 to pursue higher education.
whoCanApply: Bihar residents who passed Class 12 and are pursuing higher education, within the scheme's age limits.
benefits: Education loan up to ₹4 lakh at concessional interest (lower for women, disabled and transgender students).
process: Loan sanctioned via Bihar State Education Finance Corporation.

name: LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship
department: LIC Golden Jubilee Foundation (Life Insurance Corporation of India)
applyChannel: the LIC website during the announced window
description: Scholarship from LIC's Golden Jubilee Foundation for meritorious students from economically weaker families.
whoCanApply: Students who passed Class 10/12 or diploma with at least 60% marks, pursuing higher studies, with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.
benefits: Annual scholarship for the course duration, with a special scholarship for girl students.

rules.label: Scored at least 60% in the qualifying exam

process: Watch the LIC website for the announcement.

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships
department: Reliance Foundation
description: Merit-cum-means scholarships for first-year undergraduate students across streams, with mentoring support.
whoCanApply: Indian students in the first year of a full-time UG degree, with household income below ₹15 lakh (preference for below ₹2.5 lakh), who clear the aptitude test.
benefits: Grant of up to ₹2 lakh over the degree duration plus alumni network access.
estimatedBenefit: Up to ₹2 lakh over the degree
deadlineInfo: Applications usually open once a year.

rules.label: In the first year of a full-time undergraduate degree

name: Vidyasaarathi Corporate Scholarships Portal
department: Protean eGov Technologies (formerly NSDL e-Gov) with corporate partners
description: Single portal listing CSR scholarships from many companies, with eligibility varying by scheme.
whoCanApply: Students in school, diploma, UG or PG courses; each corporate scholarship sets its own income and merit criteria.
benefits: Multiple corporate scholarships from one registration.
deadlineInfo: Each scholarship has its own deadline.

rules.label: Meets the criteria of the specific corporate scholarship you apply to
